verdict.rationale: ImageMagick is a locally run, open-source image-processing CLI and library with no vendor-hosted storage, so choosing a storage region or residency is a hosted-service axis that does not apply to this kind of product. The distributed pixel cache and local image cache are processing features, not vendor-side data residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
